card.name: Words just before dose amounts
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or spaces right before a number or dose term, such as after 'up to', 'for', or 'times'. Also fires on a few word-internal spots like 'l-um-efantrine' and the word 'appropriately' before 'prescribed'.

modes.label: Gap before a dose or duration
modes.description: A space or small word right after 'up to' or 'for' that comes before a number and unit.
modes.example: No significant lethality was observed in dogs after single oral doses of up to<< >>10 mg/kg.

modes.label: Linking word in dose comparisons
modes.description: 'the' or 'human' inside phrases about multiples of the maximum recommended dose.
modes.example: repeated doses of up to 3 times<< the>> maximum recommended human dose of 20

modes.label: Inside artemether/lumefantrine
modes.description: The middle piece of the drug name lumefantrine in interaction lists.
